submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a local animation anatomy repair. IMAGE 1 is the 15 water-dragon scholar BOY edit target: preserve his exact identity, rendering, head/torso scale, camera and canvas placement. IMAGE 2 is the user-confirmed 09 archer gait-phase reference ONLY, use its hip-knee-ankle motion and ground-bearing mechanics, not its gender, clothing, bow, identity or hand assignment. IMAGE 3 locks the boy identity. IMAGE 4 is the approved painted finishing style. Only repair the connected trousers/legs/boots below original waist/robe. Keep exact image1 head, face, torso, hands, fan, jade and canvas scale/placement unchanged, especially original head top. Front three-quarter southwest lower-left travel. Both thighs follow fore-aft travel under pelvis rather than open sideways. LEFT support COMPRESSION matching image2 (its LEFT-leg support). Anatomical LEFT thigh from jade hip travels forward beneath center of pelvis, knee flexed for loading, left ankle beneath body, left blue boot flat planted at approx x620,y1185, toe points forward lower-left. Do NOT retain image1's left knee/boot far outside on screen-right. Far RIGHT leg curls back and its boot is tucked behind to right of front calf with coherent overlap. More knee/hip compression than an initial straight support, heel and forefoot visibly share ground plane. Preserve current hand pose while correcting lower chain. Do not merely rotate the boots or narrow the stance: correct connected thigh, knee, shin, ankle and boot wherever specified. Do not crop, zoom, resize or globally translate the boy. Keep anatomical RIGHT hand holding the ivory blue-water-dragon fan and anatomical LEFT hand empty; jade pendant on his anatomical LEFT hip. Exactly two arms/two hands/two legs/two boots. Complete single frame native 1254x1254 square RGBA with real transparent background. Keep all anatomy, fan and tassels inside canvas. No archer, bow, green costume, duplicate limbs, floor, ground shadow, effects, text, watermark or collage. Config target GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst max; actual route is host-managed builtin.
